emergent_bug.violated_requirement: ρ = atomic([read(i_mark->wd), publish into event->wd]) from thread_a -- event delivery must read a still-valid descriptor and report it without an invalidation interleaving
emergent_bug.missing_guarantee: no lock/quiesce orders mark teardown against in-flight event delivery for this field -> the invalidating write can interleave between the read and the report, so a -1 descriptor reaches userspace
emergent_bug.category_rationale: ρ is a single-access read racing an invalidating write -> data race; semantically it manifests as reading a just-invalidated value (reports wd == -1 to userspace)

fix_maps_to: patch samples wd = READ_ONCE(i_mark->wd) once, returns early if wd == -1, and reports the sampled value -> single-copy read + a validity guard; it does NOT add exclusion/order between teardown and delivery (the race is tolerated, but the invalid value is filtered)
recall_risk_notes: More 'real' than the benign cohort (a -1 descriptor reaching userspace is a visible correctness bug), so the assume is a requirement the arbiter can defend. Risks: (1) object identity across two paths -- i_mark via container_of(fsnotify_mark) in delivery vs idr lookup in teardown -- must be unified; (2) static must connect the rm_watch syscall -> fsnotify_destroy_mark -> inotify_freeing_mark -> inotify_remove_from_idr chain (some frames are outside the compiled set); (3) the design may frame it as a plain data race and still match.
